The '''Xilxash system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Yminis sector/Legends|Yminis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xilxash]].
